# Third-party notices

ggpbi is distributed as a single bundle. The `.pbiviz` you install, and
`demo/ggpbi.esm.js` in this repository, contain the compiled source of the
packages listed below — the bundler inlines them and strips their comments,
so their copyright notices are reproduced here instead.

ggpbi itself is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Nothing below
changes that; these are the terms of the code ggpbi carries with it.

41 packages, all under permissive licences (BSD-3-Clause, ISC, MIT, Unlicense).

*Generated by `npm run notices` — do not edit by hand.*
